correctness.rationale: Idempotence makes each component a fixed root with leaves. An isomorphism preserves root colour and the multiset of leaf colours. For k copies of a type with leaf multiplicities m_i the automorphism factor is k! times (product m_i!)^k. Order two thus comes only from one doubled leaf colour in one component, or one doubled rigid component type; all other leaf and component multiplicities must be at most one. This gives the two nonnegative terms in the polynomial. A sorted list of rigid weights contains every size 1 through q+1; at each step the next weight is at most one plus the preceding sum, so subset sums contain the entire interval through N_q. The internal defect can add every size from 3 through q+2; the external defect supplies size 2 and adds at most q+1 to the maximum rigid inventory. At the top size, all rigid types are present and precisely two independent colours (root and repeated leaf) specify the defect. The empty and one-point models are rigid. Orbit–stabilizer gives n!/2 labelled copies per class. Direct polynomial arithmetic gives the stated q=1 coefficients and the q=2 total 256(8+4)=3072. See RESULT.md lines 28–48 and checker.py lines 30–52, 80–125 for the frozen polynomial construction and finite diagnostic; the checker was inspected, not executed, and the all-q derivation does not require it.
